params.body:
Shares (#399) made from the workbench, through the gateway, instead of pasting into a form.

- **`POST /api/ingest/share`** (fabric, hand): writes a share from the one attached document (Markdown, UTF-8, up to 4 MB) and a passphrase hash the workbench computed. Answers the id only: the write's outcome ends up in a public evidence record, so the link is not in it.
- **`GET /api/ingest/share/{share}`** (hand, read, hand-read): the link, the state and the count of opens, never the hash or the text. The hand reads it back with its own signature right after the write.
- **`Share::checkPassphrase`** verifies `pbkdf2-sha256$<iterations>$<salt>$<hash>` beside bcrypt; a vector is pinned here and in portal-cli so the two sides cannot drift. The form is validated on the way in, so a plain word can never be stored as if it were a hash.
- A share now carries its project and the control evidence it was written on (`control_run`, `control_evidence`, `control_capability`), like an update.
- `portal.share` joins the workbench's kinds (`Capability::WORKBENCH_KINDS`) and the grant wording (`Grants::KIND_WORDS`, "Records in Portal: share a document behind a passphrase").

Tests: `IngestShareTest` (four cases), the hand-read route list extended with the new read. Pint and PHPStan clean; full suite run.

Companions: abovebeyond-ai/control (`portal.share` kind), abovebeyond-ai/elixir (the workbench's kinds), abovebeyond-ai/portal-cli (`share.mjs`).
